text:
Aisha K: Heads up — NimbusRetail showing churn signal. Usage down ~60% MoM after payments step. Renewal in 28 days. Health score 42. Need a tight rescue route.
Marco G: Ack. Do we know root cause? onboarding feedback?
Ben (CSM): They got stuck on the payments webhook step, and then no follow-ups after week 2. AE offered a self-serve script but they didn't run it. Also flagged slow embeddings for search.
Sophie L: I saw error logs — webhooks 502s around when they tried to verify card. Ticket #CR-1124.
Priya N: Engagement playbook suggestion: 1) immediate 45-min paired session to finish payments, 2) 2-week usage incentives, 3) short-term credit offer if needed.
Aisha K: Love that. Let's map owners and ETA. Quick template: "Rescue Route — NimbusRetail" with 72h SLA for first contact, 7-day activation window.
Marco G: I'll take the paired session (owner: Marco). Can do Wed 10am PT.
Ben (CSM): I'll prep a tailored enablement doc and checklist. Add a 1-click runbook for the payments webhook.
Sophie L: Eng notes: we can patch webhook retry logic in a hotfix (low risk). Estimate 2 days to test + deploy if we prioritize.
eng-triage: Created incident CR-1124-hotfix, linking deploy pipeline.
Priya N: I'll draft the incentive: 10% credit for first 30 days if they complete activation steps. Also will run an in-app guide targeted to the payments modal.
Aisha K: Decision: move forward with hotfix + paired session + incentive. If they still plan to downgrade after 14 days, escalate to AE for concession.
Ben (CSM): Action items:
- Ben: enablement doc + runbook (due 24h)
- Marco: paired session scheduled (Wed 10am PT)
- Sophie: eng hotfix triage (start today, target deploy in 48h)
- Priya: incentive email and in-app guide (due 24h)
- Aisha: I'll own the 7-day health check and renewal note to AE (due 7 days)
Marco G: I'll also record the session and drop links in the thread.
Sophie L: Quick ask for logs: Ben, can you attach a sample webhook payload they used? saves triage time.
Ben (CSM): Uploading now.
OnboardBot: Reminder: paired session scheduled with Marco G on Wed 2026-03-25 10:00 PT — add calendar invite? :calendar:
Aisha K: If eng hotfix lands, we'll insert a short smoke test in the paired session to confirm.
Priya N: I'll prepare the in-app tour steps and the email copy, sharing drafts in this thread.
eng-triage: Hotfix branch created: hotfix/payment-retry-3087. CI running.
Ben (CSM): Draft enablement doc: https://internal.docs/rescue/nimbus-payments (will update with session recording).
Marco G: Good. If we get them to complete payments + run a sample query, projected usage should recover ~45% based on similar accounts.
Aisha K: Outcome targets: restore usage to +30% baseline in 14 days OR secure a 6-month partial commitment.
Priya N: I'll include the credit terms and success checklist in the email.
Sophie L: Ping me if deploy pipeline fails. I can cut a rollback plan.
Aisha K: Thanks team — please update this thread only with progress. I'll run daily stand for 5 days. :raised_hands:
